name: Tempeh with Charred Green Onion Sauce & Lemon-Parsley Roasted Beets

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 medium beets
3 small bunches green onions (scallions)
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel and trim beets; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Divide between two baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until beets are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, trim green onions. Place on a plate, drizzle with oil, and season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, working in batches, add green onions. Grill until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side; return to the plate. (Reserve grill pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, slice tempeh crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces and place in a medium bowl. Add oil and spices, then gently toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (227g ) pkgs tempeh
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return the pan to medium-high heat. Working in batches, add tempeh in a single layer and grill, flipping once, until browned and warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Add to the plate with the green onions, loosely cover with foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the tempeh is cooking, place yogurt, mayo, water, and spices in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp mayonnaise
3 tbsp water
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Mince grilled green onions. Add to the bowl with the yogurt and whisk once more to combine the yogurt sauce. Set aside.
Juice lemons into a small bowl. Add oil, honey, Dijon, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
To serve, divide green onion yogurt and beets between plates; top yogurt with tempeh and drizzle beets with dressing. Enjoy!
